characters.name: Shira
characters.description: Girl about 8 years old, slim, warm olive skin, long dark-brown hair in one thick braid, big brown eyes, ankle-length sky-blue linen dress with a cream sash, light cream head scarf tied back loosely, sandals; always carries a small wooden paintbrush tucked in her sash.

characters.name: Yoav
characters.description: Little boy about 4 years old, chubby cheeks, warm olive skin, short curly black hair, round dark eyes, knee-length mustard-yellow tunic with a brown rope belt, barefoot or small sandals; carries a little carved wooden lion toy.

cover.prompt: Shira holds high a blue flag with a big friendly golden lion with a curly mane, standing on a gentle sand dune; Yoav beside her roars happily with his arms up, holding his wooden lion. Behind them, a wide desert camp of tents with many colorful tribal flags fluttering, and a soft white cloud resting over the Mishkan in the center. Bright morning light, low camera angle looking up at the children and the flag.

pages.prompt: A vast golden desert under a deep blue sky. A small brown goat-hair tent stands alone in the foreground. Shira sits cross-legged on a woven mat beside it, a blank white cloth spread before her, a brush in her hand and little clay pots of paint around her. Calm late-morning light, wide shot that makes the desert feel big and the girl small and focused.

Close medium shot at the tent entrance: Yoav leans over Shira's shoulder, curious, pointing at the white cloth. Shira turns to him smiling proudly, brush raised as she explains. Paint pots on the mat, a few blue drips on the cloth. Warm side light, soft shadows of the tent flap.

Overhead view of the cloth on the mat: Shira paints a large friendly golden lion with a curly mane in the middle of a sky-blue field. Yoav crouches beside it, hands raised like claws, mouth wide in a playful roar, holding his wooden lion. Shira giggles. Blue paint on her fingers. Bright, cheerful midday light.

Shira stands at the edge of her tent looking out over the camp in wonder, hand shading her eyes. Across the scene, many tribal flags flutter on poles above the tents: a red flag with flowers, a white flag with a little ship, a flag with a leaping deer, and others in green, purple and black with simple emblems, no letters. Wide shot, breezy afternoon light, fabric rippling.

Bird's-eye view of the whole desert camp: the Mishkan, a rectangular courtyard with white linen walls and a tent covered in dark coverings, sits in the center, and twelve tribal groups of tents are arranged around it in four neat sides of three, each group under its own colored flag with a simple emblem. Soft golden light, orderly and peaceful, tiny people and animals between the tents.

Shira and Yoav sit on a small rise at the edge of their tribe's tents, seen from behind and slightly to the side, looking out over the neat rows of tents and flags. Yoav looks up at her with a questioning face; Shira gestures across the camp with an open hand, explaining kindly. Late afternoon light with long shadows.

Morning departure: a soft white cloud lifts and rises above the Mishkan in the distance. In the foreground the tribe of Judah sets out first, people with bundles, donkeys loaded with packs. Shira walks at the front, lifting her blue lion flag high on a long pole, face shining with pride; Yoav trots beside her. Fresh pale-gold dawn light, dynamic low angle.

A very wide panoramic view of the long procession winding through the desert like a ribbon: tribe after tribe, each under its own flag in a different color, red, blue, green, white, purple, yellow, forming a rainbow of flags across the dunes. Shira's blue lion flag is visible small at the very front. Bright clear sky, joyful sweeping composition.

Mid-march, medium shot: Yoav tugs at the skirt of Shira's blue dress, looking up with a serious little question. Shira, still holding the flag pole, bends toward him laughing warmly. Behind them, families of other tribes walk with their colorful flags. Warm midday light, gentle and affectionate.

Evening at the tent: an oil lamp glows on the mat. Shira paints a tiny flag on a small square of cloth, while Yoav sits close against her side, eyes wide with delight as he realizes it is for him. The big blue lion flag stands planted beside the tent. Deep blue dusk sky with first stars, warm lamplight on their faces, intimate close framing.

At twilight, a circle of children from different tribes sits together on rugs in the middle of the camp, each holding a small flag of a different color. Shira and Yoav sit side by side in the circle, smiling. Tents and flag poles all around, a soft cloud glow over the Mishkan behind them. Warm, cozy, wide shot showing everyone has a place.
